subject: Media Literacy
title: The First Newspapers
description: Learn The First Newspapers in one minute.

hook.text: In 1605, a German publisher printed the first regular newspaper. It changed how people understood the world.

buildup.text: Early newspapers were weekly, expensive, and mostly read by merchants and politicians.

discovery.text: By the 1800s, the penny press made newspapers affordable for everyone.

twist.text: Cheap newspapers needed large audiences, so sensationalism replaced sober reporting.

climax.text: The business model of news — who pays and why — has shaped its content from day one.

punchline.text: When news got cheap, accuracy got expensive.

quiz.question: What happened when newspapers became affordable?
options: Sensationalism increased to attract larger audiences
